text:
Maria G: FYI — postmortem for SaltBridge onprem VPC peering isolation. Root cause narrowed to asymmetric route + MTU mismatch on their edge appliance. Need to lock owners and delivery dates for remediation items.
AJ: Thanks. Can we split into quick wins vs infra changes?
Maria G: Yes — quick wins: routing rule and MTU patch, infra changes: add BFD + healthcheck policy, add automated detection for prefix blackhole.
Sanjay P: I'll take the routing rule + MTU patch. ETA EOD tomorrow. Will create a tiny runbook.
Keval (oncall): I'll own the BFD/healthcheck policy work — need 2 sprints for rollout in Dedicated staging, then can prod push.
Lina: I'll write the detection alert (prefix-blackhole detector) — should be 3 business days. Will open a followup ticket.
Teresa: I'll coordinate with SaltBridge network team for config window and sign-off.
Maria G: Assign ticket numbers in thread please. Also add expected rollback plan if BFD rollout causes issues.
Sanjay P: Ticket: SB-4821 for MTU/rule; runbook draft: ```steps:
1) verify current route table
2) apply mtu 1496 on edge interface
3) restart peering agent
4) validate connectivity with iperf```
AJ: For the runbook, add a validation step to check KV cache warmup on the inference nodes — we saw cache miss spikes during outage.
Sanjay P: good catch, added.
Keval (oncall): Ticket: SB-4822 for BFD rollout. Rollout plan sketch: canary to 10% of peered hosts for 48h, measure drop rate and failover time. Rollback: disable BFD and revert timers.
Lina: Ticket: SB-4823 for alerting. Alert will trigger when we see >3x prefix flaps in 5m and concurrent latency spike >200ms.
Teresa: I'll book a 30m sync with SaltBridge for tomorrow 10:00 PST to confirm maintenance window and risk acceptance. Invites sent.
RemedyBot: Reminder: Incident follow-up checklist created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/SB-2026/postmortem (owned by Maria G).
Maria G: Action item tracker summary (add to ticket comments):
- SB-4821 (Sanjay) MTU+route patch — due 2026-04-02
- SB-4822 (Keval) BFD rollout — due 2026-04-16 (canary first)
- SB-4823 (Lina) detection alert — due 2026-04-05
- SaltBridge sign-off (Teresa) — meeting 2026-03-31
Please update if dates slip.
AJ: Also add a recurring postmortem review cadence: quarterly check for peering regressions for any Dedicated/Private customer.
Maria G: Agreed. I'll add to roadmap: "peering-regression quarterly review" and add owners.
Sanjay P: Quick question — is there a shared KVM access for SaltBridge edge? I need creds for patch window.
Teresa: SaltBridge gave a jumpbox with cert-based access, I have the details and will provide to Sanjay in DM once the maintenance window is locked.
Lina: I'll add a small unit test to the detection pipeline to simulate asymmetric route + MTU scenario so we avoid false-negatives.
Keval (oncall): FYI: putting a temporary circuit-level monitor in place tonight to catch recurrence during business hours.
Maria G: Thanks everyone. Please update the three tickets before EOD tomorrow and mark blockers. We'll reconvene after the SaltBridge sync. :thumbsup:
